strategy: Each text block is chunked independently; no paragraph merging. Overlap remains within one source block.

prefix_length_probe.status: diagnostic only; prefix is not added by chunk_text_run
prefix_length_probe.section_label: section with underscores replaced by spaces and uppercased

limitations: Text chunks only; tables are intentionally handled by a separate strategy.
No FAISS labels, index, benchmark or model inference produced.
Independent paragraph chunking has not been compared with paragraph merging for retrieval quality.
Real-data measurements are a one-off local tokenizer audit; the persisted pytest suite is model-free.
